title: My God can do anything
textBlocks: God is the boss of the Sun

Hello Bravehearts, in today’s true Bible story, 
we see that God can do ANYTHING
Even make the sun stand still!

(MOM PLEASE RE TELL THE STORY - JOSHUA 10)
5 Kings are cross with the people of Gibeon for making friends with Joshua.
So they plan to attack the city of Gibeon, to destroy it!
The Gibeonites ask Joshua to help them fight these 5 kings and their armies.
God tells Joshua NOT TO BE AFRAID.
God tells Joshua that He will make them win.
God makes the other armies confused .
God even throws big hailstones at them from the sky.
Joshua prays to the Lord to make the SUN STAND STILL 
so that he has more daylight to fight against all these 5 cities.

THE SUN STAYED IN THE MIDDLE OF THE SKY
it did not get dark until the battle was won.

THE LORD FOUGHT FOR THE ISRAELITES THAT DAY.

WHAT A MIRACLE! 
God can do anything!

ASK YOUR MOM TO PLAY MUSICAL STATUES, STOP STARTING THESE SONGS
so that you can freeze, like the sun stood still in today’s story!

Talk to Jesus Time
Dear Jesus
You are so big and so powerful
Help me to never forget that You can do anything.
Thank you for making the sun and all the animals
Thank you for making me me 
Amen
